tradeDemand.title: {player} wants out
tradeDemand.description: Frustrated by the {record} record, {position} {player} ({overall} OVR) has asked {team} to trade him.

choices.label: Meet with him
choices.description: Hear him out and give him a bigger voice. Lifts his mood, but the locker room notices the special treatment.

choices.label: Ignore the request
choices.description: Stand firm. He may sour further and could refuse to report.

choices.label: Shop him
choices.description: Put him on the trade block and tell him so.

extensionRequest.title: {player} wants a new deal
extensionRequest.description: {position} {player} is in the last year of his contract after a strong season and wants to talk about an extension.

choices.label: Open extension talks
choices.description: Signal that he is part of the plan. Contract talks can start now.

choices.label: Talk after the season
choices.description: Keep the focus on football for now.

choices.label: No extension
choices.description: Tell him the club is going another way.

rookieBreakout.title: {player} is breaking out
rookieBreakout.description: Young {position} {player} made a huge jump this offseason and now rates {overall} overall.

choices.label: Praise him publicly
choices.description: A boost for his confidence and for the fans.

choices.label: Promise a bigger role
choices.description: Move him to the top of the depth chart at his position.

choices.label: Keep him grounded
choices.description: Quietly remind him there is more work to do.

veteranDecline.title: {player} is slowing down
veteranDecline.description: At {age}, {position} {player} lost a step this offseason and now rates {overall} overall.

choices.label: Stand by him
choices.description: Show loyalty to a respected veteran.

choices.label: Reduce his role
choices.description: Tell him younger players will get more snaps.

choices.label: Shop him
choices.description: See what a contender would give for him.

choices.label: Back him
choices.description: Publicly support him and trust him to bounce back.

choices.label: Extra film sessions
choices.description: Pay for extra coaching time. He will grumble about it.

choices.label: Open the competition
choices.description: Tell him his job is up for grabs.

choices.label: Praise his work
choices.description: Recognise the effort he put in.

choices.label: Feature him
choices.description: Build part of the game plan around him.

lockerRoomConflict.title: Locker-room flare-up
lockerRoomConflict.description: With {team} on a {streak}-game skid, {player} got into a shouting match with teammates.

choices.label: Mediate
choices.description: Get everyone in a room and clear the air.

choices.label: Discipline him
choices.description: Fine him and make an example of him.

choices.label: Shop the troublemaker
choices.description: Put him on the trade block.

choices.label: Let him heal fully
choices.description: No shortcuts. He appreciates the patience.

choices.label: Send him to a specialist
choices.description: Pay for top-level treatment to save a week.

choices.label: Push for an early return
choices.description: Save two weeks, but he resents being rushed back.

coachDisagreement.title: Staff split over play-calling
coachDisagreement.description: {coach} disagrees with the head coach's approach after {team} averaged {value} points per game.

choices.label: Back the head coach
choices.description: The head coach has the final say.

choices.label: Side with the coordinator
choices.description: Change the approach; the head coach loses some authority.

choices.label: Staff retreat
choices.description: Pay for a few days away to get everyone aligned.

targetsRequest.title: {player} wants the ball
targetsRequest.description: {position} {player} has seen only {value}% of the team's targets and wants a bigger share.

choices.label: Promise more targets
choices.description: He will hold you to it.

choices.label: Explain the game plan
choices.description: Walk him through why the ball goes elsewhere.

choices.label: Tell him to earn it
choices.description: Blunt, but it may light a fire.

unhappyPlayer.title: {player} unhappy with his role
unhappyPlayer.description: {position} {player} ({overall} OVR) believes he should be starting.

choices.label: Name him the starter
choices.description: Move him to the top of the depth chart.

choices.label: Meet with him
choices.description: Explain the plan and his path to the field.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.description: He may turn sour.

winningStreak.title: {team} have won {streak} straight
winningStreak.description: The buzz around {team} is growing after {streak} wins in a row.

choices.label: Team dinner
choices.description: Treat the squad. Good for spirits, a small cost.

choices.label: Stay focused
choices.description: One game at a time.

losingStreak.title: {team} have lost {streak} straight
losingStreak.description: Pressure is mounting after {streak} losses in a row.

choices.label: Team meeting
choices.description: Remind everyone what they are playing for.

choices.label: Tough practices
choices.description: Hard work builds bonds, even if nobody enjoys it.

choices.label: Shake things up
choices.description: Change the routine; the fans like the energy.

rivalryGame.title: Rivalry week: {opponent}
rivalryGame.description: {team} face {opponent} next. The fans have had this one circled for months.

choices.label: Embrace the hype
choices.description: Talk it up all week.

choices.label: Just another game
choices.description: Keep the team calm.

recordBroken.title: {player} sets a record
recordBroken.description: {player} now holds the league record for {stat} with {value}.

choices.label: Celebrate the milestone
choices.description: A moment for the fans.

choices.label: Present the game ball
choices.description: Keep it in the locker room.

holdout.title: {player} threatens a holdout
holdout.description: {position} {player} wants {amount} a year and says he will not report until he gets it.

choices.label: Negotiate
choices.description: Open talks on a new deal.

choices.label: Threaten fines
choices.description: Hardball: it may bring him in, but it will not make him happy.

choices.label: Wait him out
choices.description: He stays home for now.

retirementAnnounced.title: {player} plans to retire
retirementAnnounced.description: {age}-year-old {position} {player} has told {team} he intends to retire.

choices.label: Honor his career
choices.description: Give him a proper send-off.

choices.label: Ask him to reconsider
choices.description: He might give it one more year.

fanUnrest.title: Fans are restless
fanUnrest.description: Fan support for {team} has fallen to {value}. Empty seats are showing.

choices.label: Cut ticket prices 10%
choices.description: Win some goodwill back at the gate.

choices.label: Hold a press conference
choices.description: Promise better days ahead.

choices.label: Ignore the critics
choices.description: Winning is the only answer.

sponsorOffer.title: Sponsorship offer
sponsorOffer.description: A regional company offers {amount} to become an official partner of {team}.

choices.label: Accept
choices.description: Take the money.

choices.label: Negotiate for more
choices.description: Ask for 30% more; they may walk away.

choices.label: Decline
choices.description: Not the right partner.
